units.source_text: 金阁寺也就是鹿苑寺里，本应有十三人，但现在有的应征入伍，有的征调出去，

en.t: In Kinkakuji, that is, Rokuonji, there ought to have been thirteen people, but now some had been drafted into military service and others had been called away for labor,

units.source_text: 剩下的是：一个专管向导和传达的七十开外的老头，一个年近六旬的专管炊事的老姐，

en.t: and those who remained were: an old man past seventy who was solely in charge of guiding visitors and relaying messages, an older woman nearly sixty who was solely in charge of cooking,

units.source_text: 还有执事、副执事，再加上我们弟子三人，仅此而已。

en.t: as well as the steward, the assistant steward, and, added to them, the three of us disciples; that was all.

units.source_text: 老人们已是风烛残年，少年们毕竟还是孩子。

en.t: The old people were already in the twilight of their lives, and the boys were, after all, still children.

units.source_text: 知事，也称做副司，掌管会计，尽心尽力地工作。

en.t: The chiji, also called the fusu, was in charge of the accounts and worked with complete devotion.
